_about: RER G with a stop at Chatelet-Les Halles, measured on the network model of the RER G study (project files rer-g-line4-chatelet, code stops_model.py, sens.py, crowd_runs.py): IDFM timetable of Tuesday 3 November 2026, 07:00 to 09:00, with Grand Paris Express lines 15 to 18 (the 2040 reference); INSEE census 2022 commuters by public transport on their quickest route (wait x1.5, walk x2, change 10 equivalent minutes); rule of a half with elasticity -0.8; 15 euros an hour, 205 days, commuting 55% of trips; bn a year at today's values. time: what the stop adds against RER G without stops, net of the 2 minutes lost by riders going through (low: a 3-minute stop; high: a change weighing 20 equivalent minutes). crowd_own: crowded metro and RER minutes avoided by RER G with the stop, against no RER G, own riders only, at the peak (55% of trips): low, only line 4 and RER B and D full at 4 standing per m2 (weight 1.49); central, every metro and RER line in Paris as line 1 at the peak (2.9 standing per m2 measured, Haywood and Koning 2013; weight 1.40, the study's crowding weight); high, every line at 4 per m2 and line 4 and RER B and D packed at 6 per m2 (1.79). The riders left on board are added in french.py (EXTERNAL).
